VERDICT: CHANGES — make the required merge protections explicit operator requirements.

Reviewed head: d8c168d6ba0312746e0df94e43fe007e6bb1199b.

- **[P2] `docs/safe-outputs.md:257–260`: Review and required checks are not automatic protections provided by the exemption.** This caller-facing configuration guide now states ‘Nothing merges without review and required checks’ without requiring the operator to configure those gates. The linked `docs/workflow-ingress.md:50–52` explicitly says an administrator must enforce the trusted workflow with a ruleset and that a required status name can be imitated by PR-owned workflows; `docs/workflow.md:332–333` likewise says the ingress check gates merging only after that configuration. For a caller without those protections, the exemption permits malicious workflow proposals with no enforced pre-merge review. State that operators must enforce review and the intended required checks (including the trusted ingress workflow via a ruleset if relied upon), rather than presenting these as unconditional guarantees. Workflow-approval and account-membership hardening can remain optional.

Verification: compared HEAD with merge-base 808c2652f465c5c4aa38eb7d788166d41e8b099a against origin/main; only docs/safe-outputs.md changed. `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed. `npx --yes markdownlint-cli2 '**/*.md'` passed (26 files, zero issues). An initial `npx --no-install` attempt failed because the package was unavailable locally. `lychee --offline --include-fragments --no-progress "**/*.md"` could not run (exit 127; not installed). Hosted branch/ruleset enforcement was not verified; no runtime tests were needed for this documentation-only diff.
